### Bible Pathway - Feb. 4, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-feb-4-2010-11625793.html
Passage: Leviticus 9:7
Points:
- Atonement through sacrifice was necessary to repair the broken relationship between sinful people and God.
- Sins committed through ignorance or neglect of God's Word still incur real guilt and require repentance.
- Laying hands upon the sacrificial animal symbolized transferring personal guilt onto an innocent substitute.
- Animal sacrifices only temporarily covered sin, pointing ahead to the permanent sacrifice made by Jesus Christ.
- Christ fulfills both the sacrificial offering and the high priestly office, mediating eternally for believers.
